disputed_verses.BHSA 1CH 6:24: תַּ֤חַת בְּנֹו֙ אוּרִיאֵ֣ל בְּנֹ֔ו עֻזִּיָּ֥ה בְנֹ֖ו וְשָׁא֥וּל בְּנֹֽו׃
disputed_verses.KJV 1CH 6:24: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.

first_reader_said: 1CH 6:24: Both records are Uriel son of Tahath and father of Uzziah.

why: The Uriel of 1CH 6:24, son of Tahath and father of Uzziah, belongs to the earlier Kohathite genealogy. The Uriel of 1CH 15:5 and 15:11 is the Kohathite chief serving under David, a later generation; A has combined these two men, while B represents the ancestor. The supplied text of 1CH 6:36 does not name Uriel.
